title: SE Ranking MCP: Setup & Configuration
snippet:
The Model Context Protocol (MCP) server provides a standardized interface that allows any compatible AI model to access your SE Ranking and SE Visible data simply and securely.
MCP server server follows the authenticated remote MCP spec, so it’s centrally hosted and managed. Connect in one click in [Claude](https://claude.ai/customize/connectors/id/se-ranking) or [ChatGPT](https://chatgpt.com/plugins/se-ranking), natively in Cursor and other clients, or use the `mcp-remote` module for clients that don’t support remote servers.
## What you can access
Through the MCP server, your AI assistant can work with data from these SE Ranking and SE Visible products*:
- [Data API](https://seranking.com/api/data/): keyword research, backlinks, domain analysis, SERP, and more
- [Project API](https://seranking.com/api/project/): your projects, rank tracking, audits, and competitors
- [Local Marketing API](https://seranking.com/api/local-marketing-api/): your locations, local rankings, Google Business Profile, business listings, and reviews
- [SE Visible API](https://seranking.com/api/se-visible/): your AI visibility projects, brands, topics, prompts, and sources
*The data available to you depends on your subscription. Not every API endpoint is available through MCP. Setup is the same for every product. Use your SE Ranking account, or an API key generated in the API Dashboard of your SE Ranking or SE Visible account.
## Setup Instructions
### General
Our MCP server supports Streamable HTTP transports. This transport uses OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration for authentication at the following address:
Copy
```
https://api.seranking.com/mcp
```
Jump to your client: Claude · ChatGPT · Codex · Cursor · VS Code · v0 · Windsurf · Zed · Gemini CLI · Others.

Add the official [SE Ranking connector](https://claude.ai/customize/connectors/id/se-ranking) and click **Connect**. In Claude Desktop, you can also find it under **Customize → Connectors** by searching for *SE Ranking*.

Your AI assistant connects to SE Ranking in real time, so every prompt pulls the latest available data directly into the analysis.

Data across keyword research, domain analysis, backlinks, website audits, AI search visibility, and more — all in one MCP server.

An MCP server is a connector that lets AI assistants access external tools and data sources. SE Ranking MCP connects your AI assistant to live SE Ranking data (including keyword research, backlink analysis, website audits, domain analysis, and AI search visibility) so you can ask SEO and GEO questions in plain language and get data-backed answers.

title: Setup
snippet:
The MCP (Model Context Protocol) connects SE Ranking and Planable to AI assistants like Claude and ChatGPT, so you can pull real data and draft work with plain-language prompts — no coding required.

The **Model Context Protocol (MCP)** is an open standard that connects an app's data to AI assistants. With the SE Ranking and Planable MCP servers connected, you can talk to your SEO and social data in natural language — inside tools like Claude Desktop, the ChatGPT connector, Gemini CLI, and others.
SE Ranking
## Connect SE Ranking MCP
The SE Ranking MCP server is available directly in the connector directories of Claude and ChatGPT, and can be added to other assistants via a custom connection.
- **Claude:** in **Settings → Connectors**, add the official SE Ranking connector from the directory and click **Connect** to authorize.
- **ChatGPT:** go to **Apps → Search apps → SE Ranking → Connect**, or open the [SE Ranking plugin in ChatGPT](https://chatgpt.com/apps/se-ranking/asdk_app_6a0b262d5c0c8191953dd94ba05412e2).
- **Custom connector (any MCP client):** add a custom connector with the URL https://api.seranking.com/mcp, name it **SE Ranking**, and authorize with OAuth or your API key.
Pick the connection method that fits your setup and follow the step-by-step tutorial below.

The Planable MCP connects your social workspace to your AI assistant so you can draft and schedule posts by prompt. Setup lives in Planable's own Help Center:
- **Claude:** in **Settings → Connectors**, add the official Planable connector and click **Connect** to authorize.
- **ChatGPT:** open **Apps**, search for **Planable**, and connect it — no manual URL needed, or open the [Planable plugin in ChatGPT](https://chatgpt.com/plugins?q=planable).
- **Custom connector (any MCP client):** add a custom connector with the URL https://mcp.planable.io/mcp and name it **Planable**.

title: How to build automated SEO workflows with SE Ranking MCP and GA4
snippet:
Before you start, you'll need three things:
1. **A Claude account**.
2. **SE Ranking API access**. You’ll need API credits to pull data into Claude.
3. **A GA4 property** that you have viewer access to (or higher).
* **No SE Ranking account yet?** [Start a free 14-day trial](https://seranking.com/sign-up.html). It includes 100,000 API credits — enough for everything in this guide.
If you need more credits to test our MCP, please contact us at [mcp@seranking.com](mailto:mcp@seranking.com).
*
---
## **Step 1: Connect SE Ranking to Claude**
In this step, you'll add SE Ranking as a custom connector in Claude. Once it's connected, Claude can pull live data directly from your account.
1. In Claude, open **Customize** >** Connectors**.
2. Click the **+** button and choose **Add custom connector**.
3. Fill in the details:
- **Name:** SE Ranking
- **Remote MCP server URL:** https://api.seranking.com/mcp
4. Click **Add**. SE Ranking will now show up under **Not connected**.
5. Click **SE Ranking** and then **Connect** to sign in and authorize.
That's it. Claude can now access your SE Ranking data.
**Prefer ChatGPT?** SE Ranking is also available as an official connector in ChatGPT. In ChatGPT, go to **Apps → Search apps → SE Ranking → Connect**, or open it directly at [the SE Ranking ChatGPT connector](https://chatgpt.com/apps/se-ranking/asdk_app_6a0b262d5c0c8191953dd94ba05412e2).

You can also create a **Live Artifact** — a live, interactive dashboard that you can refresh anytime to see the latest data.
You can build it using **SE Ranking data** right away.
If you’d like to include **GA4 data** as well, you’ll need to connect a separate **GA4 MCP** first.
Google’s official guide for setting up the GA4 MCP:
[developers.google.com/analytics/devguides/MCP](https://developers.google.com/analytics/devguides/MCP)
After the setup is complete, simply use the same prompt as above to generate your Live Artifact.

title: How to connect SE Ranking MCP to Gemini Spark
snippet:
SE Ranking MCP gives you access to live SEO and AI search data in Gemini Spark through plain-language prompts.
It connects as a custom app with no coding or local installation required.
***Note:** Gemini Spark and custom connected apps are currently in beta and have limited availability.*
---
Custom connected apps are currently available only in English on the [Gemini web app](https://gemini.google.com/) and mobile app. For current requirements, see Google’s guide to [connecting custom apps to Gemini Spark](https://support.google.com/gemini/answer/17209137).
### Step 1: Open the Connected Apps settings
1. Go to [gemini.google.com](https://gemini.google.com/) and sign in.
2. Switch to **Spark**.
3. Select **Connected Apps** from the sidebar.
4. Scroll down to **Custom apps for Spark**.
5. Click **Add a custom app**.

### Step 3: Link your Google Account
Link your Google Account to the SE Ranking custom app.
1. Sign in to your Google Account if prompted.
2. Review the requested permissions.
3. Click **Agree and continue**.
The permissions allow Gemini to:
- Execute SE Ranking MCP tools.
- Retrieve data needed for your requests.
- Share relevant prompt information with SE Ranking MCP.
### Step 4: Authorize access to SE Ranking
You’ll be redirected to the SE Ranking authorization page.
Choose an authorization method:
- **Sign in with SE Ranking** — recommended.
- *Enter API keys manually — alternative method.*
For the recommended option:
1. Click **Sign in with SE Ranking**.
2. Sign in to the SE Ranking account you want to connect.
3. Approve the authorization request.
Gemini uses data and API credits from the connected account.

### Step 5: Save the custom app
Gemini opens the **Save your custom app** window.
1. Review the generated app name. Optionally rename it `SE Ranking MCP`.
2. Check the available functions.
3. Click **Connect**.
You don’t need to select functions individually.
### Step 6: Verify the connection
Create a new task in Gemini Spark and enter:
***Example:** "Show me the organic and paid search stats for seranking.com across all countries. Use SE Ranking MCP."*
Gemini should use SE Ranking MCP and return organic and paid search metrics.

SE Ranking MCP requests use API credits. Available functions may change as new tools are added.

| **Gemini can’t connect to the MCP server** | Make sure the full URL is entered without extra spaces: `https://api.seranking.com/mcp` If the error continues, remove the app and reconnect.
